name: ProposedOahIndicator
title: Proposed OAH indicators
description: Indicators that citizens report but that have no concept in the OAH TemporaryOahSystem yet. Offered to the HL7 Europe OAH guide as new concepts; used as Observation.code until then.

concept.definition: Oily or rainbow film on the water surface (pollution).
Grey water, toilet paper or a pipe discharging into the stream. Follow-up by laboratory test is the coliforms indicator.
Plastic, bags or dumped items in the channel or on the banks.
The observer checked the site for signs of pollution or disease-vector habitat. Value says what, if anything, was seen.
